svg.title: Login and interactive flags independently select the zsh startup files
svg.desc: Zsh checks two independent flags. A login shell also reads .zprofile and .zlogin; an interactive shell also reads .zshrc. The focused non-login interactive case, typical of a nested shell or a new terminal tab, reads .zshenv then .zshrc only, skipping .zprofile entirely.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Login and interactive are independent — check both before editing a file.
